Special Attacks: Improved grab, constrict 2d8+12 or 1d6+6

Special Qualities: Darkvision 60 ft., ink cloud, jet, low-light vision, spell-like abilities

Imported from the d20 SRD; verify attacks and skills in-game. Full rules at d20srd.org.

system.biography:
Six of the beast’s tentacles are shorter arms about 30 feet long; the remaining two are nearly 60 feet long and covered with barbs. Its beaklike mouth is located where the tentacles meet the lower portion of its body.

Krakens speak Common and Aquan.

Combat

Krakens strike their opponents with their barbed tentacles, then grab and crush with their arms or drag victims into their huge jaws. An opponent can make sunder attempts against a kraken’s tentacles or arms as if they were weapons. A kraken’s tentacles have 20 hit points, and its arms have 10 hit points. If a kraken is currently grappling a target with one tentacle or arm, it usually uses another limb to make its attack of opportunity against the sunder attempt. Severing a kraken’s tentacle or arm deals damage to the kraken equal to half the limb’s full normal hit points. A kraken usually withdraws from combat if it loses both tentacles or three of its arms. A kraken regrows severed limbs in 1d10+10 days.

Improved Grab (Ex)

To use this ability, the kraken must hit with an arm or tentacle attack. It can then attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity. If it wins the grapple check, it establishes a hold and can constrict.

Constrict (Ex)

A kraken deals automatic arm or tentacle damage with a successful grapple check.

Jet (Ex)

A kraken can jet backward once per round as a full-round action, at a speed of 280 feet. It must move in a straight line, but does not provoke attacks of opportunity while jetting.

Ink Cloud (Ex)

A kraken can emit a cloud of jet-black ink in an 80-foot spread once per minute as a free action. The cloud provides total concealment, which the kraken normally uses to escape a fight that is going badly. Creatures within the cloud are considered to be in darkness.

Spell-Like Abilities

1/day—control weather, control winds, dominate animal (DC 18), resist energy. Caster level 9th. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Skills

A kraken has a +8 racial bonus on any Swim check to perform some special action or avoid a hazard. It can always choose to take 10 on a Swim check, even if distracted or endangered. It can use the run action while swimming, provided it swims in a straight line.

system.description: You are particularly observant.
system.benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Listen checks and Spot checks.

system.description: You are skilled at fighting opponents you cannot clearly see.
system.benefit:
In melee, every time you miss because of concealment, you can reroll your miss chance percentile roll one time to see if you actually hit.

An invisible attacker gets no advantages related to hitting you in melee. That is, you don't lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class, and the attacker doesn't get the usual +2 bonus to hit you. The invisible attacker's bonuses do still apply for ranged attacks, however.

You take only half the usual penalty to speed for being unable to see. Darkness and poor visibility in general reduces your speed to three-quarters normal, instead of one-half.
system.special: A fighter may select Blind-Fight as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can increase your defense at the expense of your accuracy.
system.benefit: When you use the attack action or the full attack action in melee, you can take a penalty of as much as -5 on your attack roll and add the same number (+5 or less) as a dodge bonus to your Armor Class. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The changes to attack rolls and Armor Class last until your next turn.
system.special: A fighter may select Combat Expertise as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: Choose one type of weapon. You are especially good at scoring critical hits with that weapon.
system.prerequisites: Proficient with weapon, base attack bonus +8
system.benefit: When using the weapon you selected, your threat range is doubled.
system.special: You can gain Improved Critical multiple times. The effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new type of weapon. A fighter may select Improved Critical as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You are exceptionally quick and alert.
system.benefit: You get a +4 bonus on initiative checks.

system.description: You are skilled at sending your opponents to the ground.
system.benefit:
You do not provoke an attack of opportunity when you attempt to trip an opponent while you are unarmed. You also gain a +4 bonus on your Strength check to trip your opponent.

If you trip an opponent in melee combat, you immediately get a melee attack against that opponent as if you hadn't used your attack for the trip attempt.
system.special: A fighter may select Improved Trip as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You have a stronger will than normal.
system.benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Will saving throws.

system.description: Make a Concentration check whenever you might be distracted (by taking damage, by harsh weather, and so on) while engaged in some action that requires your full attention.
You can use this skill to persuade others to agree with your arguments, to resolve differences, and to gather valuable information or rumors from people.
Make a Hide check to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on people without being seen or heard.
You can use this skill to frighten opponents or to get them to act in a way that benefits you.
Lands, terrain, climate, people. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Animals, fey, giants, monstrous humanoids, plants, seasons and cycles, weather, vermin. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
You can find secret doors, traps, and hidden objects.
You can get a hunch about a social situation or read a person.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.
Make a Swim check once per round while you are in the water. Success means you may swim at up to one-half your speed (as a full-round action) or at one-quarter your speed (as a move action).
You can use this skill to read a scroll or activate a magic item even if you normally couldn't use it.

What it does (SRD): If the creature hits with a listed natural weapon, it can attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity. Details (size modifiers, opposed checks, holding vs pinning) follow the grapple rules.

ThirdEra: This template has no numeric rows in Mechanical effects or Capability grants. Track grapple state in play; use the NPC’s natural attacks and CMB/CMD from the sheet when resolving the grapple.

What it does (SRD): On a successful grapple check, the creature deals extra bludgeoning damage (the amount is given in the creature’s stat block). Constrict usually requires a successful grapple after a grab-capable attack.

ThirdEra: Leave Mechanical effects and Capability grants empty here; enter the printed constriction damage and any special rules in the NPC’s Description or natural attack notes so it matches the SRD stat block.

items.name: Kraken — Jet, Ink Cloud, SLAs & Limbs

system.description:
Constrict damage (Ex): Deals automatic arm or tentacle damage on a successful grapple check after a grab — use the printed damage for the limb used (see natural attacks).

Jet (Ex): Once per round as a full-round action, jet backward 280 ft. in a straight line; no attacks of opportunity while jetting.

Ink cloud (Ex): Once per minute as a free action, emit jet-black ink in an 80-ft. spread — total concealment; treat creatures inside as in darkness.

Spell-like abilities: 1/day — control weather, control winds, dominate animal (DC 18), resist energy. Caster level 9th; save DC Charisma-based.

Limbs (Ex): Six tentacles (~30 ft.) and two longer barbed tentacles (~60 ft.); sunder rules treat tentacles and arms as weapons (hp per SRD; severing deals half limb hp to kraken; regrowth in 1d10+10 days). Often withdraws if it loses both long tentacles or three arms.

Skills: +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards; may always take 10 on Swim; may run while swimming in a straight line.
